queries_run: TransMedics Group go-to-market change 2026 business model OCS NOP
TMDX TransMedics business model transition subscription OR platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 描述商業模式以高比例經常性收入為特徵，來源為一次性 OCS 耗材組與 NOP 對移植中心提供的服務；FY2025 營收 $605.5M（+37.1%）。
findings.excerpt: Our business model is characterized by a high level of recurring revenue, which is derived primarily from sales of our single-use, organ-specific disposable sets that are required for each transplant using the OCS as well as services provided to transplant centers by our NOP.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要顯示公司正把 NOP 服務與物流模式複製到歐洲（義大利首個物流標案，並規劃義大利、荷蘭、比利時），未見訂閱制或通路去中介化的正式轉變。

channel_business_model_shift.note: 未找到訂閱制/D2C/去中介化來源；僅 NOP 服務模式地理擴張。第2則 finding 為摘要轉述，未核原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
